title: Urban Hero (with Slow Jam)
label: Lifestyle (per FACT)

type.basis: FACT (2013) places it in the period when garage was spawning grime. Held as an outgroup; little is known of its sound, so every code is drafted.

sound.text: FACT (2013) calls it one of the fattest rollers 'from that period where garage was spawning grime' (no finer detail).

context.text: Official Independent Singles Chart peak no. 48 (first chart date 25 Aug 2001).
RBMA (Dan Hancox, 2019) names Jameson among those who attended UK Garage Committee meetings with Matt Mason, Viper and Maxwell D; Mason says 'We wanted to be a voice' for the next generation.

calls.label: garage, from the period when garage was spawning grime

rels.other: Jameson and Viper – Selecta (Urban Heroes) (chart entry 14 Sep 2002, no. 51)

uncertainty: Thin. Only FACT places it in the garage-to-grime moment, and it gives no concrete sound detail. Producer, catalogue number and format are unknown. The relationship to the 2002 'Selecta (Urban Heroes)' is inferred from the title only.
tracklist: OCC lists it as 'Urban Hero/Slow Jam'.
